Phase-1 foundation training improves offline ranking metrics **by roughly 10–20%** compared with using an off-the-shelf LLM as the backbone (page 7). Table 1 states the same figure for MRR specifically: "+10-20% compared to using an OSS model as base" (page 7).

The authors say this shows how much the ranker gains from the personalization and content-understanding capabilities it inherits from the Phase-1 foundation model (page 7).

For comparison, Phase-2 post-training adds a further 35–50% gain on top of a freshly trained Phase-1 model. That gain grows to roughly 80% after two weeks (page 7).
